# Read Primitives — Broadcast Join (3 tables)

```{tags} reference, query-template, read_primitives
```

> [Read Primitives](../../read-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Read Primitives queries](index.md)

Two small tables broadcast to join with one large table

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
/* Two small tables broadcast to join with one large table. Hints are optional. */ /* + BROADCAST(n), BROADCAST(r) */ SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM supplier AS s JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name
```

## Representative DataFrame

Expression family (Polars, PySpark, DataFusion), default parameters.

```python
def broadcast_join_three_tables_expression_impl(ctx: DataFrameContext) -> Any:
    """Two small tables broadcast to join with one large table."""
    return (
        ctx.get_table("supplier")
        .join(ctx.get_table("nation"), left_on="s_nationkey", right_on="n_nationkey")
        .join(ctx.get_table("region"), left_on="n_regionkey", right_on="r_regionkey")
        .group_by("r_name", "n_name")
        .agg(ctx.col("s_suppkey").count().alias("supplier_count"))
    )
```
